id.description: Hard to guess, but not a permission check (ATT-7).

content.description: Markdown, up to 10,000 characters. Empty when left out.

version.description: Goes up by 1 on every change to the issue (S0-AC-45).

info.description: The customer portal: `/api/portal/**` on the portal host, and `/api/public/**`. Conventions: docs/integrate/conventions.md.
info.title: popdesk portal API

get.description: Only the companies the caller belongs to (S0-AC-32), in code order.
Public issues of the caller's companies and every issue the caller reported, newest first (S0-AC-47). Takes only `page` and `size`.

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `page` or `size` out of range (`OUT_OF_RANGE`), or a parameter customers may not use, such as `assignee`, `label`, `sla`, `sort` (`UNKNOWN_PARAMETER`, S0-AC-48).

post.description: Files an issue in a company the caller belongs to (S0-AC-41): key `{code}-{number}`, status `RECEIVED`, channel `PORTAL`. Send JSON, or `multipart/form-data` with the issue as JSON in part `issue` and files in parts `files` to attach them in the same request (S0-AC-56).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `title` empty or over 200, `content` over 10,000, `priority` unknown; `fields` lists all (S0-AC-42). `COMPANY_NOT_ACTIVE`: the company is not `ACTIVE`. With files: `FILE_EMPTY`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (over 10 MB), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (public attachments of the issue over 50 MB), `ATTACHMENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (team quota), and `INVALID_INPUT` with field `files` `TOO_LONG` (file name over 255) (S0-AC-57, S0-AC-58). Nothing is created then (S0-AC-63).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: the caller does not belong to the company (S0-AC-43).

413.description: `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: the request is over the upload limit.

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 uploads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it (COM-1).

get.description: Files on the issue and on its public comments, oldest first. Attachments of internal comments are left out (S0-AC-60). Deleted attachments stay as traces (`deleted`).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.description: Attaches a file to the issue, or to the caller's own comment with `commentId` (S0-AC-56). Only the reporter may attach.

commentId.description: Attach to this comment of the caller instead of the issue.

400.description: `FILE_EMPTY`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (over 10 MB), `ISSUE_ATTACHMENTS_TOO_LARGE` (public attachments of the issue over 50 MB), `ATTACHMENT_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` (team quota), `INVALID_INPUT` (field `file` `TOO_LONG`: name over 255; field `commentId` `UNKNOWN_VALUE`: not the caller's comment on this issue) (S0-AC-57, S0-AC-58). `ISSUE_CLOSED`.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller can see the issue but is not its reporter, or left the company. `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

413.description: `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`: the request is over the upload limit.

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 uploads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

delete.description: The uploader may delete. The list keeps a trace (S0-AC-61, COM-7).

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller did not upload it. `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

get.description: Always `Content-Disposition: attachment` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` (S0-AC-59). Takes `Range` requests.

206.description: Part of the file, for a `Range` request.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 16 downloads are running; try again after `Retry-After` (S0-AC-99).

head.description: The headers `downloadAttachment` would send, without the body.

200.description: The file exists and the caller may download it.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: one identical response for an unknown ID, an issue the caller cannot see, an attachment of another issue, and a pending or deleted attachment (S0-AC-102).

get.description: Oldest first (S0-AC-54). Internal comments are left out (S0-AC-53). Comments by staff have author `SUPPORT_TEAM` without name or ID (ADR D-49).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

post.description: Only the reporter may comment (S0-AC-51, S0-AC-52).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `content` empty or over 4,000. `ISSUE_CLOSED`: the issue is closed.

403.description: `FORBIDDEN`: the caller can see the issue but is not its reporter, or left the company (S0-AC-52, PROJ-4). `CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID`.

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such issue, or the caller cannot see it.

get.description: Also tells whether the session is still valid.

patch.description: A field left out keeps its value. Later email to the account uses the new language (S1A-AC-16).

400.description: `INVALID_INPUT`: `name` empty or over 50, or `null` (`REQUIRED`); `locale` not `ko` or `en` (`UNKNOWN_VALUE`), or `null` (`REQUIRED`).

patch.summary: Change the caller's name or language

put.description: Ends every other session of the account and gives this one a new session ID (S1A-AC-02, S1A-AC-17).

204.description: The password is changed. The session cookie is set again.

delete.description: Succeeds also when there is no photo (S1A-AC-24).

204.description: The account has no photo now.

post.description: Takes a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file of up to 2 MB, judged by its content. The server keeps only a copy scaled to fit 256 px and encoded again, without the original or its metadata (S1A-AC-20, S1A-AC-21). A new photo replaces the old one.

400.description: `UNSUPPORTED_IMAGE`: not one of the three formats, or it cannot be decoded (S1A-AC-22). `IMAGE_TOO_LARGE`: width times height is over 25 million pixels for PNG and JPEG, 12 million for WebP (S1A-AC-23). `INVALID_INPUT`: no `file` part (`REQUIRED`).

503.description: `SERVER_BUSY`: 2 photos are being decoded; try again after `Retry-After` (S1A-AC-88).

get.description: The caller's own photo, or that of a customer of a company the caller belongs to (S1A-AC-25). Never a staff photo (S1A-AC-26). Always PNG, with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Cache-Control: private` (S1A-AC-87).

404.description: `NOT_FOUND`: no such account, a customer of another company, an agent or admin, or an account without a photo. One body for all.

get.description: Sets the readable CSRF cookie before the first request that changes data (sign-in, accepting an invitation). Clients send its value back in a request header.

post.description: Sets the password, makes the account `ACTIVE`, and signs it in to its app (S0-AC-36). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S0-AC-101).

204.description: Accepted and signed in. The session cookie is set.

400.description: `INVITATION_INVALID`: the token is unknown, expired, used, or replaced by a newer one, or the token is sent to the other app's host (a customer's token on the console host, a staff token on the portal host); one body for all (S0-AC-37). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`).

post.description: Sets the password, lifts a sign-in lock, and ends every session of the account. It does not sign in (S1A-AC-09, S1A-AC-04). The response has `Cache-Control: no-store` (S1A-AC-14).

400.description: `PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID`: the token is unknown, over 1 hour old, used, or replaced by a newer one, the account is no longer `ACTIVE`, or the token is sent to the other app's host; one body for all (S1A-AC-10, S1A-AC-84). `INVALID_INPUT`: the password breaks AUTH-5 (field `password`: `TOO_SHORT`, `TOO_LONG`, `BLANK`, `SAME_AS_EMAIL`); the token stays usable (S1A-AC-11).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset link

post.description: Queues an email with a reset link for an `ACTIVE` account of the app of the host the request came to (S1A-AC-06). The link works for 1 hour and replaces an earlier one; a second request within 15 minutes sends nothing (S1A-AC-12). The answer is the same whether or not an email is sent (S1A-AC-05).

202.description: Taken. The same empty answer whether the email is unknown, the account is invited or suspended, or it belongs to the other app.

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 requests from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S1A-AC-13).

post.summary: Ask for a password reset email

post.description: Signs in to the app of the host the request came to: customers on the portal host, agents and admins on the console host. Creates a new session (S0-AC-17, S0-AC-21).

204.description: Signed in. The session cookie is set.

401.description: `SIGN_IN_FAILED`: the same body whether the email is unknown, the password is wrong, the account is invited, suspended, or locked, or it belongs to the other app (S0-AC-22, S0-AC-23).

429.description: `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 attempts from one IP address in 60 seconds. `Retry-After` says when to try again (S0-AC-24).

post.description: Deletes the caller's session (S0-AC-27). Succeeds also without a session.
